details.flavorMarkdown: *Burned heraldry marks a knight whose armor has become a walking tomb. Every salute is exact, every promise remembered.*
details.specialtyMarkdown:
### Oath-blackened sword

**Target:** One visible creature within 2 squares. **Player defense:** Fortitude. **Damage type:** Life.

**Weak defense:** Frightened 2 of this creature. **Standard defense:** Frightened 1 of this creature.

### Shield Hunker

Before a shield-blockable attack resolves, spend its Reaction to impose 1 Bane on player attacks it can block until the start of its next turn. The DA judges blockability. Stacks with Defend through normal Boon/Bane rules, not with another activation of itself.

### Turn the Blade

*A small turn of the wrist catches the blow on a waiting edge and sends it sliding past.*

Before one adjacent enemy makes a melee attack against this creature, impose 1 Bane on that attack roll. Requires a held melee weapon. Against an NPC attack, grant 1 Boon to the single defense roll instead. Applies to this attack only; it does not grant a counterattack.
details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

**Lifeless Body — Passive:** Does not breathe or eat; only its listed immunities apply.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 1; an explicit trait, not a bonus calculated from Size.

**Healing:** Healing-harmed: ordinary healing resolves as Life damage instead; no beneficial riders.

**Against offensive healing:** Its controller uses Fortitude defense when player-controlled; a player attacking it rolls only their attack.

**Senses:** Dark sight 6 squares; ordinary hearing.

**Tactics and retreat:** Hold the narrow ground with shield and reach. Accept a genuine oath-bound challenge rather than chase a trivial provocation.

**Encounter and conversation:** It can be held to the literal terms of its final oath, but not deceived about them.

**Habitat:** Crypt; burial ground; ruined settlement · **Communication:** Common; understands old oaths

**Loot:** Recoverable possessions or lair clues chosen for the adventure; body parts grant no automatic special equipment or coin value.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.

**Reference damage:** 5/8/11

**Reference type:** Life

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.5

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.4 → 1.5: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=2.162, O=9.518. Uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/encounters.md). Utility is provisional and does not simulate control, positioning or summon choices.

**Ability sources:** [dread cry](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/dread-cry.md), [lifeless body](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/lifeless-body.md), [shield hunker](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/shield-hunker.md), [Turn the Blade](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/monster-abilities/turn-the-blade.md).

**Coverage reference:** [Pathfinder family survey](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/295e858c1b6fee044a0261bf9f437636efeff2bf/design/bestiary/family-survey.md); original HOL prose and mechanics.

# Dread Cry

*Its cry seems to come from somewhere behind your ribs.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-dread-cry


**Action:** Main Action

A printed mental attack applies Frightened 1/2/3 on Weak/Standard/Strong, with no damage unless separately printed. The source is this creature; Banes apply while the target perceives it. The cry must be heard. Ordinary decay applies and no second save is made.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.
